lead.en: World 5 Dimensions works across IT, sciences and technology. It was founded by Maher on a five-dimensional ontology, and this site lists everything it is building, including what is only a draft.

text.en: W5D is World 5 Dimensions, founded by Maher. It operates across distinct activities in IT, sciences and technology. In the founder's own words, it is "not merely a company; it is an experiment in five-dimensional thinking".

The working ontology is short. The first three dimensions are spatial extension. The fourth is Information/Structure: the architecture of what is. The fifth is Possibility/Modality: the horizon of what is not yet but could be. Time is kept as a measure of change, not accepted as a dimension of being.

W5D describes its work as meta, macro and beyond technology: three operators, each with an institution or programme. [Dimensions](page:dimensions) and [horizons](page:horizons) explain them. The [ecosystem](page:ecosystem) lists every programme and project with one of nine status words, a dated verification, and what exists today.
